title: Spirit of Truth
definition: Spirit of Truth is a biblical title for the Holy Spirit, emphasizing His ministry of revealing, confirming, and guiding God's people in truth.
summary: The Holy Spirit leads believers into truth and bears witness to Christ.
christFocus: Jesus sends the Spirit of Truth to glorify Him and guide His disciples according to His Word.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Spirit of Truth does not lead believers into confusion, deception, or contradiction of Scripture. He bears witness to Christ, confirms the truth of the Gospel, and guides God's people in the truth God has revealed.

His ministry is especially needed because fallen hearts are vulnerable to lies. The Spirit exposes deception and anchors believers in Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many voices claim to be spiritual while leading away from Christ and Scripture. This doctrine matters because the Holy Spirit is the Spirit of Truth, not the spirit of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Spirit to help you love truth and reject lies. Test your thoughts, teachers, and desires by Scripture and by the glory of Christ.
